fonte_hash_sql: SELECT p.proname||'('||pg_catalog.oidvectortypes(p.proargtypes)||')' AS sig, md5(pg_get_functiondef(p.oid)) AS definition_md5, length(pg_get_functiondef(p.oid))::text AS definition_len, coalesce(p.proacl::text,'') AS acl, coalesce(p.proconfig::text,'') AS proconfig, p.provolatile::text FROM pg_proc p JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=p.pronamespace WHERE n.nspname='public' AND p.prosecdef;
fingerprint_sql: SELECT md5(string_agg(pg_get_functiondef(p.oid)||coalesce(p.proacl::text,''),'|' ORDER BY p.proname)) FROM pg_proc p JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=p.pronamespace WHERE n.nspname='public' AND p.proname IN ('rpc_delete_diagnostico_visita','rpc_delete_recomendacao_visita','rpc_converter_visita_em_os');
